full_text:
County of Los Angeles Department of Public Social Services
12860 Crossroads Parkway South, City of Industry, CA 91746
Date: 03/18/2026

Re: Nicolas Hernandez — Case No: [redacted]

The California Department of Social Services has notified this office that you have requested a State hearing to dispute a County decision made on your case. An Appeals Hearing Specialist will review your case to attempt resolution without the need for a formal hearing. Once the case is reviewed, the specialist will contact you or your authorized representative.

You have the right to be represented by an authorized representative during the call and at the State hearing. Free legal assistance may be available from Neighborhood Legal Services of Los Angeles County or the Legal Aid Foundation of Los Angeles.

You also have the right to free interpreter services. If you requested your State hearing before the effective date of the action you disagree with, your benefits may continue during the appeal (Aid Paid Pending). For questions, you may contact the Appeals Hearing Specialist at the phone numbers provided.

Appeals & State Hearings Section
3833 S. Vermont Ave., 4th Floor
Los Angeles, CA 90037

Mailing envelope and postage details follow.
